entities.name: UniProt Q9UDV6 ZNF212
observations: The 495-aa query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed human zinc finger protein 212 (UniProt Q9UDV6).
UniProt annotation says ZNF212 may participate in transcriptional regulation and localizes to the nucleus; GO includes DNA-binding transcription factor activity and zinc ion binding.
Sequence/Pfam analysis identifies a KRAB domain at residues 148–180 and four C2H2 zinc-finger domains around residues 316–338, 369–394, 428–449, and 455–477.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 55.45 kDa, theoretical pI 6.97, GRAVY −0.736; these do not account for modifications or complexes.
